notes: The details are for the 2021 Explore E+ 1 only and may not carry over to other Explore E+ models or years.

gaps: No exact model code was found.
It does not say the motor is brushless, gives no battery management system, and does not state the display size or location.
method: Giant's 2021 Explore E+ 1 product page gives the motor, 500Wh battery, 6A charger, display and lights recorded here.
The page calls the motor a mid-drive motor.
Ext and obs ratings are research judgment, not source facts.

comps.spec: Giant EnergyPak Smart 500, 36V integrated Lithium-Ion battery (Battery line). The feature text calls it a 500Wh EnergyPak Smart Battery. Explore E+ 1, 2021 page.
Giant SyncDrive Sport motor, 70Nm torque (Motor line). The page text calls it a small mid-drive motor with a maximum 70Nm of torque; it does not say brushless.
Giant EnergyPak Smart 6A charger (Extras line). The same line says the bike is compatible with the Giant EnergyPak Plus range extender. Explore E+ 1, 2021 page.
Axa BlueLine 50Lux Steady E6 front light and Axa BlueLine Steady E6 rear light (Lighting line). Explore E+ 1, 2021 page.
Giant RideDash EVO display (Display line). Explore E+ 1, 2021 page. Size and location are not stated on the page.

sources.title: Giant Explore E+ 1 Electric Bike, 2021 (Giant product page, Ireland site)
sources.note: Gives the motor, battery, charger, display, control unit and lights used in the parts above.
